segments.description: Retailer and distributor of automotive replacement parts and accessories through stores and online platforms in the Americas.
segments.evidence: The Company is a leading retailer and distributor of automotive parts and accessories through the Company's 8,031 stores in the Americas.

revenueModel.text: Customers, including DIY buyers and commercial accounts such as repair garages, dealers, service stations and fleet owners, pay AutoZone for automotive parts, accessories and software purchased in stores or online.
revenueModel.evidence: We also sell automotive hard parts, maintenance items, accessories and non-automotive products through www.autozone.com, and our commercial customers can make purchases through www.autozonepro.com.

changes.text: In fiscal 2025, the Company combined all its previously defined operating segments into a single operating and reportable segment.
changes.evidence: During the fourth quarter of fiscal 2025, the Company combined all its previously defined operating segments into a single operating and reportable segment to align with how the Company is currently managed and evaluated.
